keyPoints: Rekhik samikaran me char ki ghat 1 hoti hai — 3x + 5 = 20 ek char wala rekhik samikaran hai.
Hal karne ke liye char wale pad ek taraf, sankhyaen doosri taraf lao: 3x = 15 se x = 5.
Koshthak (brackets) hon to pehle kholo: 2(x + 3) = 16 se 2x + 6 = 16, phir 2x = 10, x = 5.
Dono taraf char hon to chhote gunank wale pad ko doosri taraf le jao: 5x - 9 = 2x + 6 se 3x = 15, x = 5.
Bhinn wale samikaran me dono taraf har ke LCM se guna karke bhinn hatao: x/2 + x/3 = 10 me 6 se guna karo.
Umar, sankhya, paisa ke sawalon me agyat ko x maan kar samikaran banao — phir hal karke uttar jaancho.
Aam galti: pakshantar me chihn badalna bhoolna ya bhinn me LCM se guna karte samay kisi pad ko chhod dena.
subject: Maths
title: Ek Char Wale Rekhik Samikaran
